예레미야애가 5:1.content: Remember, O Lord, what is come upon us: consider, and behold our reproach.

예레미야애가 5:2.content: Our inheritance is turned to strangers, our houses to aliens.

예레미야애가 5:3.content: We are orphans and fatherless, our mothers are as widows.

예레미야애가 5:4.content: We have drunken our water for money; our wood is sold unto us.

예레미야애가 5:5.content: Our necks are under persecution: we labour, and have no rest.

예레미야애가 5:6.content: We have given the hand to the Egyptians, and to the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread.

예레미야애가 5:7.content: Our fathers have sinned, and are not; and we have borne their iniquities.

예레미야애가 5:8.content: Servants have ruled over us: there is none that doth deliver us out of their hand.

예레미야애가 5:9.content: We gat our bread with the peril of our lives because of the sword of the wilderness.

예레미야애가 5:10.content: Our skin was black like an oven because of the terrible famine.

예레미야애가 5:11.content: They ravished the women in Zion, and the maids in the cities of Judah.

예레미야애가 5:12.content: Princes are hanged up by their hand: the faces of elders were not honoured.

예레미야애가 5:13.content: They took the young men to grind, and the children fell under the wood.

예레미야애가 5:14.content: The elders have ceased from the gate, the young men from their musick.

예레미야애가 5:15.content: The joy of our heart is ceased; our dance is turned into mourning.

예레미야애가 5:16.content: The crown is fallen from our head: woe unto us, that we have sinned!

예레미야애가 5:17.content: For this our heart is faint; for these things our eyes are dim.

예레미야애가 5:18.content: Because of the mountain of Zion, which is desolate, the foxes walk upon it.

예레미야애가 5:19.content: Thou, O Lord, remainest for ever; thy throne from generation to generation.

예레미야애가 5:20.content: Wherefore dost thou forget us for ever, and forsake us so long time?

예레미야애가 5:21.content: Turn thou us unto thee, O Lord, and we shall be turned; renew our days as of old.

예레미야애가 5:22.content: But thou hast utterly rejected us; thou art very wroth against us.
